$description: Semantic roles. Dark is the product's default; light is the prefers-color-scheme variant.

backdrop-start.$description: Landing backdrop gradient. Not surface: the backdrop is its own plane, and tying it to a surface role would move it whenever cards change.

warm.$description: The warm counterweight. Everything the eye lands on is otherwise cool, and the warmth of the palette lives only in the ground; this is the one ink allowed to answer it — empty states, illustration, decorative marks. Deliberately not interactive: the accent owns actions, and a warm control would compete with the warning tone.

mark-ink.$description: Logo, the band that carries the accent.

accent-glow.$description: Accent at 30% — the agent-activate halo. Alpha is baked in; there is no alpha channel in the CSS var otherwise.

aurora-tint.$description: Mocha at 20% — peak tint of one landing gradient layer. They overlap, so the backdrop reaches higher.

card-shadow.$description: The dark theme separates surfaces with border and tone, not shadow.

mark-ink-light.$description: 2.79 against the light ground — under the 3.0 non-text bar, which exempts logotypes. Do not reuse for controls.

aurora-tint.$description: Mocha at 38% — the light ground needs more tint to show the same bloom.
